explanation: This test case partially covers the rollback behavior on timeout but does not explicitly verify that the FX rate was locked at initiation (fx_lock) or that the destination wallet was credited before the funding source was debited (credit_before_debit). It also does not cover the dual approval requirement for top-ups above SGD 10,000. The test checks that the wallet balance is unchanged and funding source not debited after a timeout, which relates to rollback, but it lacks explicit assertions about the order of credit and debit or FX rate locking. It also misses verifying the approval process for large top-ups.
missingAssertions: Verify FX rate is locked at the moment top-up is initiated
Verify destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited
Verify second business owner approval is required for top-ups above SGD 10,000
hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: A bug where the FX rate is not locked at initiation and fluctuates during processing would not be caught because the test does not check the FX rate at any point. Also, a bug where the destination wallet is debited after the funding source is debited would not be caught because the test only checks final balances, not the order of operations. Finally, a bug where top-ups above SGD 10,000 proceed without second-owner approval would not be caught as this scenario is not tested.

suggestedReplacement.description: Verify top-up transaction rollback on payment provider timeout and enforcement of FX rate lock and dual approval
steps: Initiate a top-up of SGD 15,000 and record the FX rate at initiation
Verify the destination wallet is credited before the funding source is debited
Simulate payment provider callback timeout after 5 seconds
Verify that the transaction is rolled back: wallet balance and funding source remain unchanged
Initiate a top-up of SGD 15,000 and verify that a second business owner approval is required before settlement
suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: FX rate is locked at initiation; destination wallet credited before funding source debited; transaction rolled back on timeout with no balance changes; top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement
